"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The world's worst instances of environmental degradation have occurred under governmental control.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The most economically advanced countries also have the strongest environmental protections.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Balancing environmental goals with economic growth and job creation has made possible investment needed to safeguard natural resources, protect endangered species, and create healthier living conditions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"State and local initiatives to clean up contaminated sites have exceeded efforts directed by Washington.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Progress in cleaning up contaminated sites can continue if grounded in sound science, long-term planning, and a multiuse approach to resources.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Government at all levels should protect private property rights by cooperating with landowners' efforts and providing incentives to protect fragile environments, endangered species, and maintain the natural beauty of America.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Republican leadership has led to the rejuvenation and renewal of the National Park system.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Future expansion of the National Park system, as well as designation of National Wilderness areas or Historic Districts, should be undertaken only with the active participation and consent of relevant state and local governments and private property owners.",

```
